name: argus-marketplace
description: Argus — agentic multi-perspective code review plugin for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode Desktop, and the DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

scripts.build: npm --prefix plugins/argus install && npm --prefix plugins/argus run build
scripts.install:opencode-desktop: npm --prefix plugins/argus install && npm run gen-hosts && npm --prefix plugins/argus run install:opencode-desktop
scripts.install:dsh: npm --prefix plugins/argus install && npm run gen-hosts && node plugins/argus/scripts/install-dsh.mjs
